photos.title: Crescent Beach, North Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: The Crescent Beach section of North Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: the beach, a few oceanfront buildings, and streets of beach houses among trees behind them.
photos.caption: The streets behind the oceanfront at Crescent Beach in North Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: Streets of two-story beach houses among trees behind the oceanfront at Crescent Beach in North Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean
photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24 at 500 ft, about 1,200 ft offshore, Nikon D1X, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180608d.jpg from 11CCH03_0824_180500.zip; aircraft position 33.803372 N, 78.695848 W (the position of the plane, not of the houses). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX.

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/strategies/small-multifamily/ on 2026-11-10: the beach, oceanfront buildings and streets of raised houses behind them at Crescent Beach. The caption names no building and does not say which houses hold more than one home.
